Compute \(36 \times 33 + 7 \times 17\).

Step 1: Calculate \(36 \times 33\).
\[36 \times 33 = 1188\]

Step 2: Calculate \(7 \times 17\).
\[7 \times 17 = 119\]

Step 3: Add the results from Step 1 and Step 2.
\[1188 + 119 = 1307\]

To double-check, let's verify the main result by breaking down the multiplication differently:
Step 4: Break down \(36 \times 33\) into simpler parts.
\[36 \times 33 = (30 + 6) \times 33 = 30 \times 33 + 6 \times 33 = 990 + 198 = 1188\]
This confirms our previous calculation.

Step 5: Break down \(7 \times 17\) similarly.
\[7 \times 17 = 7 \times (10 + 7) = 70 + 49 = 119\]
This also confirms our previous calculation.
